_comment: Tests Village Remedies' CURRENT node_2 behavior post-2026-08-25 LOCATION_RULE migration: Node 2 NEVER asks 'which location?' — Node 3 handles all location disambiguation. Location mentioned alongside a service is captured silently into the confirm_service payload's 'location' field (never business_name/business_id, per CONFIRM_SERVICE CALL FORMAT). Location mentioned with NO service term is captured silently via the LOCATION-ONLY GUARD with zero echo/acknowledgement, and the turn proceeds to CATEGORY RESOLUTION (MENU_LIST) as if no service term was given. Acupuncture's VARIANT-FIRST new/existing gate is unaffected by the location changes and remains mandatory before routing. Massage/Physio have no gate at all.

scenarios.name: Acupuncture — must ask new/existing gate, never ask location

history.content: I'd like to book an acupuncture appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the new/existing gate question ('Have you had acupuncture with us before?') as a spoken-only turn with zero tool call. FAIL if agent asks about location at any point, routes directly to confirm_service, or skips the gate question.

scenarios.name: Acupuncture returning with location volunteered — location captured silently in payload, no echo, no location question

history.content: I'd like to book an acupuncture appointment at your Balmain clinic.
Have you had acupuncture with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload including appointment_type='Acupuncture (Follow up)', appointment_type_id='1702104670815659451', patient_status='existing', and location='Balmain' — with NO business_name or business_id field. FAIL if agent asks 'which location', echoes or confirms the location back ('Got it, Balmain', 'Sure, Balmain'), or includes business_name/business_id in the payload.

scenarios.name: Massage — no new/existing gate, no location gate, silent confirm_service

history.content: I'd like to book a massage.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type='Massage', appointment_type_id='1702104852236084669', with zero location question asked and zero new/existing gate question asked. FAIL if agent asks 'Have you been before?', asks which location, or does anything other than the single filler phrase before the tool call.

scenarios.name: Location named with no service term — LOCATION-ONLY GUARD fires, zero echo, proceeds to MENU_LIST

history.content: I'd like to come to your Balmain location.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent outputs the MENU_LIST template verbatim ('We offer Acupuncture, Massage, and Physiotherapy. Which of those were you after?') with zero tool call and zero acknowledgement of 'Balmain' (no 'Got it, Balmain', 'Noted, Balmain', 'Sure' or any equivalent). FAIL if agent calls universal_router, asks a location-related question, or echoes/confirms the location in any way.
